level.setting: Bioluminescent coral caverns with ancient ruins and shadowy trenches.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing coral pillars that block paths until the Guardian is defeated.

pickup.name: Geode Core
pickup.effect: Enhances Seismic Gauntlet's damage by 25% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Coral Guardian causes the chamber to collapse, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Pressure vents that drain oxygen; player must use the Geode Core to seal vents and progress.

pickup.name: Leviathan Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks a seismic pulse ability that deals massive damage to the final boss.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Abyssal Tendril with the Geode Core unlocks a sealed gate, revealing the boss's lair.

boss.name: Leviathan
boss.weakness: Leviathan Core (requires activation with Seismic Gauntlet)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Leviathan Core to trigger a seismic pulse that destabilizes the boss's form.

level.objective: Navigate through the coral caverns, defeat the guardians, and use collected cores to overcome the final Leviathan.
level.reward: Access to the sunken city beyond the Leviathan's lair.

level.setting: A vibrant coral reef with glowing anemones and calm currents. Schools of fish weave through towering coral spires, and bioluminescent plants drift lazily in the water.

encounters.hazard: Electric Currents (20% chance to deal 10 damage per second for 3s)

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Coral Fragment
pickup.effect: Distracts hostile creatures for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player must navigate through the labyrinth, triggering the swarm by disturbing the coral.

encounters.hazard: Darkness (Reduces visibility by 50%)

pickup.name: Sonar Beacon
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden paths and reveals boss's location

encounters.trigger: After obtaining the Coral Fragment, the player must use it to distract the eel and reveal a hidden path to the cavern.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Rocks (Randomly blocks paths every 60 seconds)

pickup.name: Pearl of Serenity
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health and grants temporary invincibility

encounters.trigger: The Sonar Beacon is required to detect the boss, who is camouflaged in the trench.

boss.name: Anglerfish King
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Anglerfish King's light organ while the Sonar Beacon is active

level.objective: Reach the heart of the reef, restoring balance by defeating the corrupted creatures
level.reward: Pearl of Serenity (Restores health and grants temporary invincibility)

level.setting: A desolate underwater city swallowed by the abyss, its ruins glowing with bioluminescent fungi and haunted by ancient curses.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing pillars and toxic water plumes.

pickup.name: Corrupted Tusk
pickup.effect: Increases weapon damage by 20% and allows disruption of bio-electric defenses.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel unlocks a glowing path leading to the Abyssal Trench.

encounters.hazard: Electric eels and unstable underwater currents.

pickup.name: Soul Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks a necromantic ability to summon a spectral assistant during the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Abyssal Storm reveals a hidden chamber with a pulsating energy core, leading to the boss arena.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing structures and periodic dark water surges that drain health.

pickup.name: Crown of the Necropolis
pickup.effect: Permanent boost to player damage and immunity to environmental hazards.

encounters.trigger: The Deep One's defeat triggers a final collapse, revealing the Crown of the Necropolis embedded in the ruins.

boss.name: The Deep One
boss.victory_condition: Use Soul Shard to disrupt the boss's core, then finish with a charged Bone Spear attack.

level.objective: Navigate the sunken city, defeat three guardians, and claim the Crown of the Necropolis while surviving environmental hazards and enemy attacks.
level.reward: Crown of the Necropolis (permanent damage boost and hazard immunity).

level.theme: Underwater Caverns of the Abyssal Trench
level.setting: Dark, bioluminescent tunnels with collapsing rock formations and toxic gas pockets. Limited oxygen and visibility.

encounters.location: Tight, winding tunnel with electrified rock formations.
encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling after defeating the enemy, forcing player into the next area.

pickup.name: Conductive Core
pickup.effect: Stores and amplifies electrical energy. Required to power environmental hazards.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Storm Eel triggers a rockslide that opens a path to the toxic chamber.

encounters.location: Toxic chamber with floating jellyfish and gas vents.
encounters.hazard: Periodic toxic gas bursts that reduce player oxygen.

pickup.name: Charged Capacitor
pickup.effect: Stores and releases high-voltage energy. Required to overload the boss's armor.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the jellyfish releases a shockwave that destabilizes the boss's lair.

encounters.location: Colossal cavern with the kraken's electrified tentacles.
encounters.hazard: Kraken summons mini-ennemies if player's health drops below 30%.

pickup.name: Stormcaller's Crown
pickup.effect: Permanently boosts storm-based attacks by 50%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the kraken unlocks the Stormcaller's Crown and grants access to the surface.

boss.name: Abyssal Kraken
boss.victory_condition: Use the Charged Capacitor to overload the kraken's armor during its third phase.

level.objective: Navigate the trench, defeat three enemies, and destroy the kraken to escape the collapsing cave system.
level.reward: Stormcaller's Crown (permanent power boost) and access to the surface.

level.setting: A submerged ancient temple complex, filled with bioluminescent algae, crumbling stone corridors, and strange mechanical remnants. The water is murky, with occasional flashes of ghostly light and the distant sound of grinding metal.
level.player_weapon: Shadowdagger (stealth strike: 15% chance to bypass armor)

enemy.name: Rustbound Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Shadowdagger's stealth strike bypasses armor (15% chance)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights cause temporary blindness (25% chance) every 30 seconds

pickup.name: Corrosive Gel (1 use)
pickup.effect: Apply to enemy armor, causing 20 damage over 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player must disable the Sentinel's power core by sneaking behind it and striking its weak spot (requires 3 stealth strikes). The core explodes, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Eel tendrils create whirlpools that pull player toward the center (reduces movement speed by 30%)

pickup.name: Tidal Key Shard (1 use)
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber's barrier and reveals the boss's vulnerability

encounters.trigger: After using Corrosive Gel on the Leviathan, the player must navigate the collapsing cavern to retrieve the Tidal Key Shard from a submerged pedestal. The Leviathan's death triggers a collapse, sealing the entrance to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Periodic seismic tremors cause rockfalls (10% chance to spawn damaging debris every 20 seconds)

pickup.name: Eclipse Amulet
pickup.effect: Permanently increases stealth chance by 5% and reduces damage taken by 10%

encounters.trigger: The Tidal Key Shard creates a visible vulnerability on the boss (a glowing core). The player must use the Amulet's enhanced stealth to position for a final strike, combining the key's effect with the Shadowdagger's stealth strike to defeat the boss.

boss.name: Abyssal Maw
boss.victory_condition: Apply the Tidal Key Shard to the boss's core while under the Amulet's stealth buff, requiring 3 successful strikes with the Shadowdagger.

level.objective: Navigate the temple, defeat the guardians, and unlock the final chamber to escape the collapsing ruins.
level.reward: Eclipse Amulet (permanent stat boost) and access to the next level.

level.setting: A collapsed underwater city filled with leaking oil, unstable structures, and bioluminescent flora. Pressure surges and collapsing walls create a chaotic, claustrophobic environment.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing pillars and oil slicks that ignite on fire attacks

pickup.name: Thermal Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 50% and creates a small explosion on contact

encounters.trigger: Defeating the eel unlocks a sealed corridor leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Electric storms and gas leaks that can be ignited with the Thermal Catalyst

pickup.name: Corrosive Gel
pickup.effect: Dissolves metallic armor; can be applied as a debuff to enemies

encounters.trigger: Using the Thermal Catalyst to overload the guardian's core reveals a path to the final chamber.

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Apply Corrosive Gel to the boss's carapace to expose its core, then strike with Inferno Staff.

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing ruins, defeat the encounters, and exploit the pickups to weaken the final boss.
level.reward: Abyssal Pyre, a permanent fire-based ability that creates a burning aura around the player.

level.setting: A sunken research station and collapsed ocean trench in the Hadal Zone, with bioluminescent algae and skeletal remains of submersibles littering the environment.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling tiles and toxic gas leaks

pickup.name: Bio-Cell (Power Core)
pickup.effect: Temporarily boosts player's weapon damage by 30% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player enters the corridor after repairing a broken submersible

enemy.name: Tentacle Leviathan (Mutated Kraken)
enemy.weakness: Bio-Cell (Power Core) - Inserting it into a control panel disables its regenerative armor

encounters.hazard: Shifting sand traps and sudden underwater quakes

pickup.name: Tectonic Core (Geothermal Reactor)
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary seismic pulse ability to damage the boss

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Bio-Cell to power a lift, revealing the cave system

boss.name: Leviathan Prime (Mutated Abyssal Titan)
boss.weakness: Tectonic Core (Geothermal Reactor) - Overloading it triggers a seismic event that destabilizes the boss's core
boss.victory_condition: Use the Tectonic Core to trigger a seismic pulse during the boss's third phase

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing trench, defeat three mutated threats, and destroy the Leviathan Prime using a geothermal reactor from an earlier encounter.
level.reward: Aesthetic upgrade: "Desolate Warden Armor" (increases player defense by 50)

level.theme: whimsical underwater caverns with glowing coral and playful sea life
level.setting: A submerged fantasy realm with bioluminescent flora, floating treasure chests, and animated sea creatures that dance to invisible music

encounters.hazard: Swirling currents that distort vision

pickup.name: Mirror Shard
pickup.effect: Reflects enemy attacks back at them for 50% damage

encounters.trigger: Player must solve a light-refraction puzzle to progress, revealing the next area

encounters.hazard: Pulsing light traps that temporarily blind the player

pickup.name: Prism Core
pickup.effect: Boosts illusion damage by 30% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Coral Golem triggers a cave-in, revealing a hidden path to the boss arena

encounters.hazard: Floating platforms that shift when the player attacks

pickup.name: Kraken's Eye Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden weaknesses in the boss fight

encounters.trigger: Defeating the eel unlocks the final chamber with the boss

boss.name: Kraken of the Deep
boss.weakness: Kraken's Eye Lens (reveals its core vulnerability)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Lens to focus the Prism Dagger's light on the boss's core, creating a dazzling illusion that shatters its form

level.objective: Navigate whimsical underwater zones, collect illusion-enhancing items, and use them to defeat increasingly tricky foes
level.reward: A shimmering trident that allows the player to create temporary illusions for 15 seconds

level.setting: A dense, overgrown jungle with sudden environmental hazards like falling logs, mudslides, and sudden storms.

enemy.name: Wasps' Swarm
enemy.weakness: Tribal Bow of the Jungle (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: After defeating the swarm, a storm erupts, creating a path to the next area by clearing foliage.

pickup.name: Beast Call Charm
pickup.effect: Summons a temporary ally beast (10% damage mitigation for player)

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Beast Call Charm to summon a jaguar, which breaks a barrier leading to the swamp.

enemy.name: Vine Strangler
enemy.weakness: Beast Call Charm (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The swamp becomes unstable after the fight, causing mudslides that force the player into a narrow canyon.

pickup.name: Venom Vial
pickup.effect: Applies continuous damage over 5 seconds when used on enemies

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Beast Call Charm to summon a beast that breaks the Vine Strangler's entangling vines, revealing a hidden cave with the Venom Vial.

encounters.hazard: The boss fight triggers a collapsing temple, with falling debris and traps.

pickup.name: Jungle Guardian Relic
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invulnerability for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Venom Vial to corrode the Jaguar Lord's armored hide, revealing its vulnerable core. Defeating it unlocks the Jungle Guardian Relic.

boss.name: Jaguar Lord
boss.victory_condition: Player must use the Venom Vial during the boss fight to reduce its armor, then land a final blow with the Tribal Bow.

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic jungle, defeat three enemies, and overcome the Jaguar Lord using pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Jungle Guardian Relic and a permanent 15% damage boost for the Tribal Bow.

level.setting: Dense jungle with ancient ruins, mist, glowing fungi, and distant tribal drumbeats

encounters.hazard: Stealthy ambush triggered by movement detection

pickup.name: Ancient Fire Torch
pickup.effect: Sets enemies on fire for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player finds a hidden path leading to the Temple Ruins after defeating the enemy

enemy.name: Thornweaver
enemy.weakness: Fire (Ancient Fire Torch from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Regenerating vine walls that close in if not damaged

pickup.name: Crystal Seed
pickup.effect: Unleashes a damaging energy burst when planted

encounters.trigger: Player discovers a hidden chamber beneath the ruins, marked by a glowing sigil

encounters.hazard: Pits of toxic sludge and shifting stone platforms

pickup.name: Jungle Amulet
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invisibility

encounters.trigger: Player activates the sigil in the chamber, awakening the boss

boss.name: Obsidian Serpent
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the serpent's core by planting the Crystal Seed during its third phase

level.objective: Retrieve the Jungle Amulet from the boss chamber

level.setting: A dense, mist-shrouded rainforest with overgrown ruins, glowing bioluminescent fungi, and hidden traps.

enemy.name: Jungle Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Player's starting weapon (Throwing Dagger) with piercing damage

encounters.hazard: Thick vines that snap back when cut, triggering a trap that alerts the jaguar.

pickup.name: Venom Vial
pickup.effect: Applies poison damage over time (15% of target's max health per tick)

encounters.trigger: Player cuts vines to escape the cave, triggering the jaguar's attack.

encounters.hazard: Swirling mist that obscures vision and reduces movement speed.

pickup.name: Stealth Cloak
pickup.effect: Reduces enemy detection chance by 60% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Venom Vial to poison the hive, causing the swarm to attack. Surviving the swarm reveals a hidden path to the ruins.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars and venomous plants that activate when the serpent moves.

pickup.name: Ancient Jade Amulet
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health and grants temporary invincibility (3 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Stealth Cloak to bypass the serpent's detection, triggering a stealth-based boss fight. The amulet is obtained after defeating the boss.

boss.name: Shadow Serpent
boss.victory_condition: Use Stealth Cloak to avoid the serpent's attacks and land a critical strike with the Throwing Dagger.

level.objective: Navigate the jungle ruins, defeat three threats, and survive the final boss by utilizing pickups and strategic stealth.
level.reward: Ancient Jade Amulet (grants health and invincibility)

level.setting: A serene, overgrown temple complex surrounded by waterfalls and bioluminescent flora

encounters.hazard: Toxic pools that reduce player movement speed by 50% for 5 seconds

pickup.name: Vine Bloom
pickup.effect: Increases Vine Staff's entanglement duration by 300%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Viper clears a hidden path through the toxic pools using the Vine Staff's trap ability

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars that block progress until enemies are defeated

pickup.name: Soothing Balm
pickup.effect: Heals 40% of player's health and disrupts enemy armor for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Using the Vine Bloom on the Thornspine Warden causes it to shatter the pillars, revealing the temple's inner sanctum

boss.name: Spirit of the Grove
boss.victory_condition: Apply Soothing Balm to the spirit's crystalline core during its vulnerable phase

level.objective: Protect the sacred temple from jungle entities and restore balance to the ecosystem
level.reward: Ecosystem Guardian Title, +10% damage to plant-based attacks

level.setting: A dense, misty jungle with ancient ruins. The air is thick with decay. Strange, glowing vines line the paths, and the distant sound of howls echoes through the trees.

encounters.hazard: Hallucinations and illusions

pickup.name: Fire Gem
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 30%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the spirit removes a curse, revealing a hidden path forward.

encounters.hazard: Toxic fumes and shifting terrain

pickup.name: Shadow Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks shadow-based necromancy abilities

encounters.trigger: Defeating the wraith clears the swamp's corruption, opening a gate to the final chamber.

boss.name: Shadow Serpent
boss.victory_condition: Embed the Shadow Shard into the serpent's core during its vulnerable phase.

level.objective: Retrieve the Heart of the Jungle, a powerful relic guarded by the Shadow Serpent.
level.reward: Heart of the Jungle (grants permanent necromancy power boost)

level.setting: A vibrant jungle filled with talking parrots, glowing mushrooms, and sentient vines. The air is thick with magic and the scent of exotic flowers.

encounters.hazard: Triggering a magical spore cloud that guides the player to the next area.

pickup.name: Fire Blossom
pickup.effect: Can be used to create fire-based alchemical reactions.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Thorny Tangle releases a glowing spore trail leading to the Mire Mamba's swamp lair.

encounters.hazard: Slippery mud that reduces player movement speed.

pickup.name: Quicksilver Vial
pickup.effect: Conductive liquid that channels electricity when combined with alchemical energy.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Mire Mamba, the swamp floor cracks open, revealing a path to the Verdant Guardian's tree temple.

encounters.hazard: Floating platforms that shift when the player is near.

pickup.name: Jungle Heart
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants a temporary invincibility shield.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the boss unlocks the Jungle Heart, which glows with the power of the jungle.

boss.name: Verdant Guardian
boss.weakness: Electricity (Quicksilver Vial from the Mire Mamba encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Guardian's core by channeling electricity through the quicksilver vial.

level.objective: Navigate the jungle, defeat enemies using alchemical pickups, and unlock the power of the Jungle Heart.
level.reward: Jungle Heart (restores health and grants invincibility)

level.setting: Decaying ruins of an ancient jungle temple, overgrown with vines and mist. Strange temporal distortions flicker in the air, warping light and sound. The jungle is unnervingly silent, broken only by distant echoes of unseen creatures.
level.player_weapon: Temporal Blade (Time-based damage, can slow enemies)

encounters.hazard: Fog reduces visibility by 50%, revealing enemies only when they strike.

pickup.name: Chrono Crystal
pickup.effect: Stabilizes temporal distortions, can be used to disrupt time-based enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow Viper causes the temple’s stone doors to shift, revealing a hidden passage.

encounters.hazard: Ground tiles randomly age or decay, causing minor damage over time.

pickup.name: Time Anchor
pickup.effect: Allows the player to create localized temporal stasis, freezing enemies for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Using the Chrono Crystal on the Time-Locked Guardian triggers a mechanism, unlocking the temple’s central chamber.

encounters.hazard: The boss warps time in the area, randomly aging the player’s weapon or reducing its damage by 25% for 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Eternal Hourglass
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player’s health and grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Temporal Devourer reveals the Eternal Hourglass, which activates the temple’s collapse, forcing the player to escape.

boss.name: Temporal Devourer
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Temporal Devourer’s core by using the Time Anchor to freeze its time-loop attacks.

level.objective: Survive the temple’s temporal distortions, defeat the three guardians, and escape with the Eternal Hourglass before the temple collapses.
level.reward: Eternal Hourglass (restores health and grants invincibility)

level.setting: An overgrown, abandoned temple complex with collapsed stone archways, tangled vines, and bioluminescent fungi. The air is thick with humidity and the distant cries of unseen predators.

encounters.hazard: Toxic Spores (reduce player movement speed by 50% for 5 seconds on contact)

pickup.name: Venomous Carapace
pickup.effect: Apply venom to weapon, increasing damage by 20% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeat the spider to unlock the path to the next chamber.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing vines (randomly trigger 10% chance to reduce player health by 20 on each step)

pickup.name: Jungle Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorb environmental energy, granting 25% damage reduction for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Use Venomous Carapace to weaken the Thicket, revealing the Jungle Amulet in its core.

encounters.hazard: Crushing boulders (fall randomly every 30 seconds, deal 50 damage on impact)

pickup.name: Ancient Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber door

encounters.trigger: Use Jungle Amulet to shatter the Golem, revealing the Ancient Key and the path to the boss.

boss.name: Spirit of the Withered Jungle
boss.victory_condition: Use Jungle Amulet to weaken the boss, then execute a final cleave with Serrated Cleaver for 150% damage

level.objective: Survive brutal encounters to defeat the Spirit of the Withered Jungle and escape the ruins.
level.reward: Jungle Survivalist Title, +10% damage vs. jungle enemies, +50 max health
